cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:58744a1c-8fd1-4a.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! POSITION PURPOSE The Residential Maintenance Technician reports to the Property Manager under the supervision of the Maintenance Supervisor and performs general maintenance and repair to ensure apartment units and other property facilities are maintained per CIM Group operating and safety standards. Responsibilities include diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) units; electrical appliances, outlets, and light fixtures; plumbing, carpentry, and locks. Additional responsibilities include, but are not limited to, assisting with preparing vacant apartment units for rental and following a planned preventative maintenance schedule. Please note this is a talent pool posting; it will remain open to applications on an ongoing basis. We are always looking for talented individuals for this role as positions become available. Join our talent pool today to be considered for future opportunities.
qualifications: High school diploma, GED or equivalent.
Must possess a valid state-issued driver’s license.
One to three years of experience in facility maintenance and/or mechanical repair required.
HVAC experience required.
EPA Type II or Universal and/or Pool Certification required at hire or within 90 days of assuming the position.
MS Office including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook.

foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.description: Start Date: September 2026 Contract Length - 6 months with possibility to extend 👋 HEY, WE'RE FOUNDERS FACTORY Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Headquartered in London and operating globally, Founders Factory backs visionary founders with capital, dedicated support from a team of expert operators, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry leading corporate partners. Since 2015, FF has backed 450+ portfolio companies helping them to secure over 500 enterprise pilots with blue chip corporate partners such as Aviva, Northwestern Medicine, Johnson & Johnson Innovation, and HSBC. THE OPPORTUNITY: We are looking for a Venture Builder who is passionate about building the future of occupational safety. Climate change is no longer a background risk for the people who work outdoors or underground — it's an active occupational hazard. Miners and construction workers are increasingly exposed to extreme heat and degraded air quality, driving up rates of heat stress and pulmonary disease. You’ll be working on our new venture: a medical-grade wearable device paired with a real-time data dashboard, designed to monitor at-risk profiles among miners and construction workers, flag early signs of heat stress and respiratory strain, and give employers the visibility they need to intervene before a health incident becomes a fatality. 🔍 WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? As a Venture Builder, you specialise in taking ideas from zero to venture-backable businesses. You work closely with founders to shape strategy, validate problem spaces, build MVPs, and find early product market fit. This is a hands on, high ownership role. You'll operate across product, design, growth and tech, moving fast, making decisions, and focusing relentlessly on what creates the most leverage at each stage of a venture. You have a varied skill set and will have demonstrated an interest in tech and entrepreneurship. You will be an advocate for FF's values and mission and be committed to supporting founders. You are opinionated but evidence led, creative but commercial, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. You care deeply about building products people actually want and businesses that can scale. Please note that we are looking for Venture Builders who are available for an initial 6 month contract (freelance) in Australia. Preferred locations are Melbourne and Perth. 💪 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: - Owning the end-to-end early build: from problem definition and MVP scoping through to shipping, testing, and iteration - Getting products into users' hands fast, using lean, experimental approaches to validate assumptions and generate learning - Shaping the customer experience and product vision, balancing user needs with commercial and technical realities - Working closely with founders to challenge thinking, sharpen focus, and drive momentum, especially when things feel unclear or uncomfortable - Helping ventures progress through studio stage gates, supporting founders towards strong, evidence-backed IC decisions - Spotting opportunities early by staying close to market dynamics, emerging tech, and real user behaviour - Communicating clearly and regularly, sharing progress, learnings, trade-offs, and recommendations with founders and the wider studio 🎯 REQUIRED SKILLS, EXPERIENCE AND MINDSET: - You’re coming from a background in digital health, medicine or wearables - You think in systems, not just devices: you can connect a sensor on someone's body to a dashboard an employer actually checks, and you understand what "real-time" needs to mean when the risk is heatstroke, not a missed notification - You've been through a regulatory clearance or licensing process for a health or safety product and know that compliance isn't a box to tick at the end — it shapes the product from day one - Driving momentum by subscribing to lean methodologies and an experimental approach, you prioritise speed, learning, and

jobgether-jobgether:lever:424781ce-2c8e-.title: Engineering Manager - Product
jobgether-jobgether:lever:424781ce-2c8e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Manager - Product based in Portugal. This is an opportunity to lead a high-impact product engineering team within an early-stage, fully distributed software environment. You’ll guide a compact group of engineers responsible for turning customer needs into valuable, reliable product capabilities. The team works across cloud spend management, data pipelines, visualization, and intuitive product experiences. You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to ensure engineering priorities remain aligned with customer needs and business goals. The role combines people leadership, delivery ownership, technical judgment, and organizational development. You’ll have meaningful influence over engineering standards, team growth, hiring, and how products move from idea to launch. It’s an ideal opportunity for an experienced engineering leader who thrives on autonomy, collaboration, and building high-performing teams in a fast-moving environment. Lead, coach, develop, and grow a compact product engineering team while maintaining a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing culture. Establish clear priorities, maintain alignment across the team, remove delivery blockers, and ensure consistent progress toward product goals. Partner closely with Product and Design to translate customer needs and business priorities into focused engineering initiatives. Guide the team in balancing delivery speed, technical quality, reliability, and long-term maintainability when making engineering tradeoffs. Enable engineers to take ownership of features from initial concepts and technical planning through implementation, testing, and launch. Establish and maintain practical standards for software design, testing, documentation, technical decisions, and engineering processes. Support recruiting, onboarding, mentoring, and development of new engineering talent as the organization grows. Strengthen collaboration across engineering, product, design, and leadership to ensure decisions are clear and execution remains coordinated. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and strong communication. Help the team deliver dependable and performant product capabilities across spend management, data, visualization, and application infrastructure. Requirements Proven experience managing and developing software engineering teams, ideally within a product-focused technology environment. Demonstrated ability to build high-performing teams, develop engineers, and create an environment where people can do their best work. Strong product mindset with the ability to understand customer needs, business priorities, and technical considerations when setting engineering direction. Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to maintain clarity across multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. Strong judgment when balancing velocity, engineering quality, technical debt, and customer impact. Experience enabling engineers to own features and projects throughout the complete development lifecycle. Comfortable operating in an early-stage or rapidly evolving environment where processes and priorities continue to develop. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Product, Design, and senior leadership. Experience with or familiarity with modern software development environments such as TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Terraform, GCP, dbt, and Dagster is beneficial but not mandatory. Experience leading engineers within a young startup is a strong plus. Exposure to FinOps, cloud infrastructure, cloud cost optimization, or data platforms is advantageous. Hands-on experience with a comparable modern technology stack is also a plus. Benefits Base salary of up to $300,000 CAD , plus additional compensation

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7b527d37-c409-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Communications Specialist based in United States. This role supports communications for a major federal healthcare technology modernization program, helping stakeholders navigate system changes, enhancements, and post-launch operations. You will develop clear, timely, and audience-focused communications that support organizational readiness and adoption. The position combines strategic communication planning with hands-on writing, editing, stakeholder engagement, and content coordination. You’ll work closely with government stakeholders and internal teams to ensure messaging is accurate, consistent, and aligned with established standards. Your work will contribute to transparency and effective change management across a large, complex healthcare environment. Strong stakeholder management, organization, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and approval workflows. msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The Part Time Building Operations Supervisor will manage the daily activities of the custodial team and monitor back of house operations during events at The Chicago Theatre. The position’s focus is on facility operations and the oversight of associated building systems as well as the supervision of the event driven staff. What will you do? Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? Detail-oriented and able to work on multiple projects effectively in a fast-paced, event driven environment. Ability to develop good working relationships with all levels of management Proven conflict resolution experience. southparkcommons-junior-ai:ashbyhq:90f24.description: 👶 ABOUT JUNIOR We’re building cutting-edge LLM-powered workflow tools to supercharge investment research for private market investors. Our clients include most of the global top 10 private equity and consulting firms - Junior already powers hundreds of billions of dollars invested annually. We’re a profitable, bootstrapped company with a growing team of 30+ based in London, NYC and Sydney. We 10x’d our revenue in 2025. You can read more about the company mission & values here https://myjunior.notion.site/join-junior-2026?source=copy_link. 💡 ROLE DESCRIPTION Customer success is critical to our business. We will only ever hire people who have done the job. You should deeply empathise with the pressures faced by consultants and investors doing DD work, and how Junior can support them to deliver faster and with greater impact. We’re looking for candidates who can ‘walk the walk and talk the talk’. We are serving the largest logos in the industry and we need your help to drive adoption, satisfaction and retention with our users. You will manage global deployments of 1000s of users. You will act as the Voice of the Customer, interfacing between our users and product team to make sure we are laser-focussed on eliminating the worst parts of our customers’ work. As an early member of our Customer Success team, you'll have the unique opportunity to: - Own, build and nurture strong relationships with customers, including senior stakeholders at large cap funds and consultancies, acting as their primary point of contact and trusted partner through the onboarding, usage and feedback journey - Plan and execute large scale AI deployments of 1,000s of users - Act as the voice of the customer and see their needs rapidly transformed into new product features; guide the product team as to what they should be building to satisfy customer demands - Co-design training with our customers and deliver it - Leverage data to effectively drive customer usage, satisfaction and retention - Rapidly progress into a managerial role for an expanding customer success team - Shape the structure and processes of the customer success team, and more broadly our company culture 🔥 ABOUT YOU We're looking for an experienced customer success lead who: - 2+ years consulting - ideally CDD (no industry skew needed) OR 2+ years in PE OR 3+ years of customer success / product / data analytics experience in a startup / scale-up - Should have an active interest in AI and thoughtful opinions on how it will impact our industry - Is highly responsive and has excellent communication and presentation skills and a desire to own client relationships - Has a strong ability to prioritise and execute, driven by customer needs and business impact, and is quick on their feet when it comes to solving customer issues - Has an exceptional work ethic, with a rigorous focus on high-quality client outcomes and operational excellence - Is a collaborative team player with strong and clear opinions they are unafraid to share to make things better - Will take a rigorous approach to customer analysis, reporting and data-driven decision making**, and can write basic database queries (e.g., SQL)** - Advanced prompting capability with ChatGPT and/or other LLM tools within professional workflows - Native / highly fluent in English 🌵 WHY JUNIOR? - Private health insurance and a Third Space membership - Lunch provided every day at our NYC HQ, plus dinner when working late - Multiple all-expenses-paid team offsites each year — recent trips include Crete and Cancun - Join a close-knit, ambitious team building one of the fastest-growing AI companies in financial services 📩 HOW TO APPLY If you're excited about the opportunity to drive innovation at Junior, we'd love to hear from you! We can't wait to meet you! 🙌
